title: The Complexity of Limited Belief Reasoning — The Quantifier-Free Case
reasoning: The paper is a technical analysis of the computational complexity of epistemic logic (the formal logic of knowledge and belief). Although 'epistemic' relates to epistemology, the paper is purely focused on the algorithmic complexity (PSPACE, NP, PTIME) of reasoning levels in AI systems, not on evaluating or benchmarking religious faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical values.
